items.title: Industry welcomes TPR consultation on defined benefit surplus release
items.summary: The Pensions Regulator has launched a consultation on draft guidance setting out factors for trustees to consider when deciding how to use defined benefit surpluses.

items.title: TPT Investment Management launches £215m UK property fund
items.summary: TPT Investment Management has launched a £215m UK property fund utilising the Reserved Investor Fund structure.

items.title: UK financial watchdog warns tech companies over AI agents offering financial services
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has warned technology firms that AI agents performing regulated tasks will face scrutiny, coinciding with Meta launching its Muse agent in the UK.

items.title: Ardonagh MGA appoints UK CEO and UK chair
items.summary: Ardonagh MGA has appointed a new UK chief executive and UK chair following leadership moves from Dual and Allianz.

items.title: Allianz UK updates metalworking and precision engineering insurance proposition
items.summary: Allianz UK has refreshed its Commercial Select mid-market policy for metalworking and precision engineering businesses, adding psychological injury support, higher stock limits and enhanced workmanship cover.

items.title: Liberty Specialty Markets creates UK and MENA technical lines division
items.summary: Liberty Specialty Markets has combined its construction, energy, and risk engineering operations into a new regional division led by James Boyle.
